title: Signed totalization of the perfect formula
statement:
For a bounded finite-projective complex $F^\bullet$, the total arrows
$\pi_{h,E,F}$ and $\rho_{h,E,F}$ are inverse isomorphisms.

proof.text: Use the supplied K-injective representative K with repE. The strict-perfect package is K-flat with flat terms by StrictPerfectCoefficientPackage.isKFlat_flat. The canonical tensor pullback theorem supplies the same property for uStar(F), so the canonical mixed tensor representative isomorphisms eC and eB are available. The bounded split-perfect target total is K-injective by tensorAdjunctionTotal_target_isKInjective. All these interfaces are declared in def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows and lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback.

Apply the forward representative identity lem-weil-pbc-projection-formula-mixed-representative: pi followed by eB.hom is eC.hom followed by Q(t). The ordinary signed total mate t is invertible by tensorAdjunctionTotal_isIso, and the specified inverse s is its uniquely determined inverse.

Unfold only the pair of arrows: rho is eB.hom followed by Q(s) and eC.inv. For pi followed by rho substitute the forward representative identity, use functoriality to combine Q(t)Q(s), then the chain inverse identity t followed by s equals 1, and eC.hom eC.inv equals 1. For rho followed by pi postcompose with the monomorphism eB.hom, substitute the same representative identity, cancel eC.inv eC.hom, combine Q(s)Q(t), and apply the second chain inverse equation. Cancel eB.hom. These equations are complete Lean proofs; no inverse equation is assumed by the new representative lemma.
